module: Flowgraph node "Manage Vehicle Pool" (once_instant). Sets and reads a vehicle pool: maxActive (max number of active vehicles; -1 or nil = unlimited), globalPoolingMode (useSceneVehiclesCap: limits the active vehicles of the whole scene). Outputs: vehicleIds, activeVehIds, inactiveVehIds, activeAmount, inactiveAmount. Requires the core_vehicleActivePooling module; the pool object comes from the Create Vehicle Pool node.

workOnce.desc: Applies the settings to the pool then publishes its vehicle lists and their counts.
